description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prickly Pair, adding {C}{C}.
When Prickly Pair dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Prickly Pair from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Prickly Pair enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
